Label: Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders
Purchase type
Help Text: Purchase typeThe purchase-order type assigned to newly created purchase orders by default. A "journal" is a draft purchase order that doesn't have inventory transactions and can't be confirmed. A "purchase order" can have inventory transactions and can be confirmed, received, and invoiced. Use "returned order" when returning goods to a vendor; it has a return material authorization (RMA) number and order lines with negative quantities.

Label: Return action default
Help Text: Return action defaultSelect the standard return action that is created by default when you enter return item quantities in a purchase order line.

Label: Purchase pool
Help Text: Select the purchase pool that you want to appear by default on a purchase order when it is created on the Purchase order page. If you do not want to use the default purchase order pool, you can change it for a specific vendor or on a specific purchase order.

Label: Prompt when specifying vendor and invoice account
Help Text: Prompt when specifying vendor and invoice accountSelect this option to display a message when you create or modify a purchase order. The message indicates that vendor's term information, such as terms of payment, from the Vendors page will be copied to the purchase order. If you do not select this option, the information will be copied and no message will be displayed. Basic information about the vendor, such as account number, is copied to a purchase order whether this option is selected or not.

Label: Prompt quantity field value when posting documents
Help Text: Recommend a value for quantity field when posting documents.

Label: Automatically recalculate FactBoxes on purchase order update
Help Text: Automatically recalculate FactBoxes on purchase order updateSelect this check box to automatically recalculate FactBoxes when a purchase order line is added or changed. The recalculation process can slow system performance. If you do not select this check box, you must press F5 to refresh the FactBoxes after purchase order lines are added or changed.

Label: Calculate purchase order delivery date based on lead time and working days
Help Text: Enable this parameter to calculate a delivery date based on the lead time for Procurement documents. The date will not change if the lead time is zero.

Label: Select calendar to determine working days
Help Text: Select calendar to determine working daysSelect the calendar that specifies the days your agency is open, such as weekdays, and the ‘Closed for pickup’ check box is selected to indicate weekends and holidays.

Label: Disallow renumbering of lines
Help Text: Select this check box if synchronization to Common Data Service is enabled and you want to avoid renumbering purchase order lines because it can create inconsistent references to lines.

Label: Enable change to Bill-to address on Purchase orders
Help Text: Enable change to Bill-to address on Purchase ordersSelect this option to enable a different Bill-to address to be chosen on Purchase orders. The bill‐to address will default from the Invoice-type address that has been associated with the operating unit and position of the worker who is creating the purchase order.

Label: Exclude cancelled lines from totals calculation
Always default line delivery address from the header
Help Text: Always default line delivery address from the headerWhen this parameter is enabled, the delivery address for the purchase order line will always default to the purchase order header address, disregarding any site or warehouse-specific delivery addresses.

Label: Enable default line sales tax group from delivery address configuration
Help Text: When this parameter is enabled, the sales tax group for the purchase order line will default from the sales tax group associated with the delivery address specified for the purchase order header. When disabled, the sales tax group will default to the sales tax group associated with the purchase order header.

Label: Block modifications to Purchase Order Line Unit Price after line has Product Receipt for 1 or more quantity.
Help Text: Block modifications to Purchase Order Line Unit Price after line has Product Receipt for 1 or more quantity. When this parameter is Enabled user cannot modify unit price of Purchase Order Lines after line has Product Receipt for 1 or more quantity.

Label: Give purchase orders created via purchase requisitions Draft approval status
Help Text: If this option is selected, the approval status of a purchase order that is created from a purchase requisition will be Draft.

Label: Purchase order prices/amount
Help Text: Purchase order prices/amountPrint prices and amounts on purchase order documents.

Label: Activate change management
Help Text: Select this check box to enable change management for purchase orders.

Label: Allow override of settings per vendor
Help Text: Allow override of settings per vendorSelect this check box to allow users to override change management settings on a per vendor basis.

Label: Find purchase agreements
Help Text: Select this check box to search for a purchase agreement when you create an intercompany purchase order from the original sales order.

Label: Retain concurrent update warningChoose whether the system should allow users to receive warnings when simultaneous edits of the same purchase order header occur. Additionally, setting this to "Yes" will also prevent purchase order header from being refreshed while open, and it can impact various purchase order update scenarios with purchase order table extensions. If you do have relevant extensions, you should keep this set to No. Yes
Retain concurrent update warning
Help Text: Retain concurrent update warningChoose whether the system should allow users to receive warnings when simultaneous edits of the same purchase order header occur. Additionally, setting this to "Yes" will also prevent purchase order header from being refreshed while open, and it can impact various purchase order update scenarios with purchase order table extensions. If you do have relevant extensions, you should keep this set to No.

Label: Skip purchase line alerts upon purchase updates
Help Text: Choose whether the system should allow custom features to receive alerts when a purchase update event occurs in the purchase order line (PurchLine). Setting this to "Yes" will prevent custom features from receiving these alerts, even when specifically requested by a custom feature. Setting this to "No" will allow the alerts to be generated, but can impact system performance, especially if your system is integrated with Dynamics 365 Sales through dual-write. If you don't have any relevant customizations, you should keep this set to "Yes".

Label: Allow inactive intercompany relationships
Help Text: Allow inactive intercompany relationshipsChoose whether the system should allow inactive intercompany relationships to exist. Setting this to "Yes" the system will not prevent saving intercompany relationships as inactive. If you have relevant extensions that depend on inactive relationships to exist, you should set this to "Yes".

Label: Auto-create direct delivery intercompany orders originating from purchase order creation
Help Text: Choose whether the system will automatically create intercompany orders. This parameter applies for a scenario with 4 or more intercompany orders in the chain when the originating order is an intercompany purchase order. In that case, system will automatically create remaining orders without a need to navigate to the newly created intercompany sales order to trigger the creation of remaining intercompany orders in the chain. Furthermore, this parameter is ignored in the creation of intercompany return scenarios. If you are creating exclusively intercompany return scenarios, you should set this parameter to "No".

Label: Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders
Accept underdelivery
Help Text: Accept underdeliverySelect this check box to allow under deliveries to be accepted as a final delivery.

Label: Accept overdelivery
Help Text: Select this check box to receive more items through the packing slip update than the quantity that you ordered on the purchase line.

Label: Safety level of invoiced orders
Help Text: Safety level of invoiced ordersSpecify whether to allow changes to a fully invoiced purchase order. None - You can add new order lines to an invoiced purchase order. Warning - you can add new order lines to an invoiced purchase order, but a warning message is displayed. Locked - you cannot make any changes to an invoiced purchase order.

Label: Check quantity for decimal precision
Help Text: Select this option to prevent a receipt of a quantity different from what the decimal precision rule prescribes for the unit.

Label: Supplier requested and confirmed shipment dates
Help Text: Supplier requested and confirmed shipment datesSupplier requested and confirmed shipment dates enables you to do the following: - Determine the supplier's shipping calendar on the vendor and its subsequent default to the relevant document. - Determine the delivery transport days from the supplier to the receiving point. - Enhance the purchasing process through the incorporation of new Requested and Confirmed ship dates. - Consider the supplier's shipping calendar and transport days for the automatic calculation of supplier ship dates.

Label: Consolidate sales orders for direct deliveries
Help Text: Choose whether the "Create direct delivery orders" batch job should consolidate qualifying sales orders into a single purchase order when creating a direct delivery.

Label: Copy markup auto-charges after conversion to delivery schedule lines
Help Text: Copy markup auto-charges after conversion to delivery schedule linesDuring the initial conversion of the delivery schedule, any existing markup charges on the original lines are removed. When this parameter is enabled, the system automatically reapplies the appropriate markup charges to the newly generated delivery schedule lines. When disabled, which is the default behavior, the markup charges are not re-added after the original ones are deleted.

Label: Check for product receipt number used
Help Text: Select how duplicate product receipt numbers per vendor should be maintained.

Label: Generate charges on product receipt
Help Text: Generate charges on product receiptSelect this to automatically allocate charges when products are received.

Label: Registered quantity selection
Help Text: Select which quantities are posted when you process purchase order product receipts. Select Use only registered if the registered quantity is selected in the Quantity field on a product receipt, and you want to limit posting to only include registered transactions. Select Prioritize marking over registered if the limitation that you specify with the registered quantity value should be disregarded and the system will allow for transactions, other than registered transactions, to be posted.

Label: Documents per task
Help Text: Documents per taskEnter the maximum number of purchase documents to be processed by each batch task when posting confirmations and product receipts.

Label: Lines per task
Help Text: Enter the maximum number of purchase order lines to be processed by each batch task when posting confirmations and product receipts. Set to zero to disable this limit and use the "Documents per task" setting instead. When this field is set to a value other than zero, then the "Documents per task" setting is ignored.

Label: Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders
Discount
Help Text: DiscountSelect the method to determine how the total discount is calculated if a line discount and a multiline discount are both effective for a certain purchase order line.

Label: Find auto charges for header
Help Text: Find auto charges for headerSelect this check box to automatically allocate charges for purchase order headers when they are created.

Label: Find auto charges for line
Help Text: Select this check box to automatically allocate charges for purchase order lines according to the charges set up for the ordered items.

Label: Calculate total discount on posting
Help Text: Calculate total discount on postingSelect this option to automatically calculate the total discount when purchase orders are posted. Any total discount information that has been manually entered will be overwritten.

Label: Enable price details
Help Text: Select this option to let users view price details for purchase order lines. To access the Price details page, in the Purchase order page, on the Purchase order lines FastTab, click Purchase order line, and then click Price details. The Price details page displays detailed information about the prices, agreements, and trade agreements that are associated with the selected product, and calculates discounts, rebates, margins, and royalties for the order line.

Label: If you change price and discount conditions, prices and discounts could get recalculated and overwritten. You could also trigger a dialog. The dialog helps you decide whether to keep the current price or discount if the price or discount is inherited from an external source. Add the types of external sources that should trigger this dialog.

Apply price discount calculation when importing purchase order linesThis parameter will allow purchase line price discount calculation when importing sales order lines. This is useful in integration scenarios when price discount is calculated externally. No

Label: Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders
Purchase type
Help Text: Purchase typeThe purchase type assigned by default to newly created requests for quotation (RFQs). This establishes what the result will be when the RFQ is accepted. A "purchase order" is an agreement to purchase a specific quantity or value of product from a vendor. A "purchase agreement" is an agreement to purchase a specific quantity or value of product over time. The "purchase requisition" type can only result from RFQs that were created from a purchase requisition--you can't select this type as a default value.

Label: Solicitation type
Help Text: Solicitation typeSelect a solicitation type to insert on requests for quotation by default.

Label: Bid type
Help Text: Bid typeSelect if RFQs by default are open, meaning visible to other vendors bidding, or sealed, meaning only visible to the vendor bidding.

Label: Days offset
Help Text: The number of days entered in this field is added to the system date when a request for quotation is created, and results in the default expiration date for the request for quotation.

Label: Working days
Help Text: Working daysSelect this check box to use working days from the company calendar instead of all calendar days when calculating the expiration date for a request for quotation.

Label: Expiration Time
Help Text: Enter the time of the day when the RFQ expires.

Label: Mode of delivery
Help Text: Mode of deliverySelect a mode of delivery to apply by default to a request for quotation.

Label: Delivery terms
Help Text: Select delivery terms to apply by default to a request for quotation.

Label: Terms of payment
Help Text: Terms of paymentSelect delivery payments to apply by default to a request for quotation.

Label: Default trade agreement journal
Help Text: Select a trade agreement journal to apply by default to request for quotation trade agreements.

Label: Lock RFQs when they are sent
Help Text: Lock RFQs when they are sentSelect this check box to lock RFQs by default when they are sent. Locked RFQs can only be changed by selecting Create in the Amendment section on the Quotation tab on the RFQ case.

Label: Lock selected fields on response lines
Help Text: When selected, the Quantity, Unit, Description, and Charges on Purchase fields will be locked on lines that are not alternates

Label: Email template for notification of amendments
Help Text: Email template for notification of amendmentsSelect a template to use by default for emails about amendment of requests for quotation.

Label: Email method for notification of amendments
Help Text: Select the method that is used to send email. - SSRS Report: an email is sent as part of generating the report using the SSRS report. This option should be used if only a few email recipients should receive the email or if the report should be delivered as an attachment to the email. - Email distributor: an email is sent using the email distributor framework. With the email distributor option, the email can be monitored in the Batch email sending status. This option should be used when emails are sent to many recipients. When using the email distributor option, the report cannot be sent as an attachment.

Label: Email template for notification of canceled RFQ
Help Text: Email template for notification of canceled RFQSrmParameters_Cancel_CancelSysEmailTable

Label: Email method for notification of canceled RFQ
Help Text: Select the method that is used to send email. - SSRS Report: an email is sent as part of generating the report using the SSRS report. This option should be used if only a few email recipients should receive the email or if the report should be delivered as an attachment to the email. - Email distributor: an email is sent using the email distributor framework. With the email distributor option, the email can be monitored in the Batch email sending status. This option should be used when emails are sent to many recipients. When using the email distributor option, the report cannot be sent as an attachment.

Label: Purchaser can edit vendors bid
Help Text: Purchaser can edit vendors bidSelect this check box to allow purchasers to edit a vendor bid when replying to requests for quotation.

Label: Encryption key expiration day offset
Help Text: The number of days entered in this field is added to the system date when encryption key for sealed request for quotation reply is created, and results in the default expiration date for the encryption key.

Label: Purchaser can mark and process multiple lines
Require unique alternate line product names
Assign Automatic Charge for PO
Help Text: Assign Automatic Charge for POThis parameter lets you to include automatic charges in Purchase Orders created from RFQ bids accepted. 1. When this parameter is enabled - The automatic charges will be included in the purchase orders created from RFQ based on automatic charge codes configured for vendor and item code. 2. When this parameter is disabled - The automatic charges will not be included in the purchase orders created from RFQ, even though automatic charge codes configured for vendor and item code.

Label: Send All Lines Default Status
Help Text: Send ALL Lines Default Status will be applied based on below configuration 1.All - Display All Vendors irrespective of Lowest or Highest Status of Vendor 2.Created - Display Vendors with Either Lowest or Highest Status as Created 3.Sent - Display Vendors with Either Lowest or Highest Status as Sent

Help Text: Show the RFQ description FastTabSelect this option to make the RFQ description FastTab visible on the Request for quotation page

Show only delivery addresses for workers when creating category-based purchase requisition lines
Help Text: Show only delivery addresses for workers when creating category-based purchase requisition linesSelect this option to prevent users from seeing workers' home addresses when creating category-based purchase requisition lines. Instead, only addresses marked with a “Purpose” of “Delivery” will be shown. Addresses marked for both home and delivery purposes will be available, but users will not be able to see that the address is also a home address.

Label: Update financial dimensions on change item
Help Text: Choose whether the financial dimensions specified on a purchase requisition line should automatically update when you change the item number for a new or existing line. Set this to "Yes" to update all financial dimensions to match the new item number for the line. Set to "No" to keep the previous financial dimension values and change only the item number.
